defect_1_intent_was_only_memory.my_comment_had_claimed: launch intent is persisted before anything is attempted
defect_1_intent_was_only_memory.now: a SEPARATE <token>.intent.json written before the barrier and before any transport, carrying attempt identity, request ids, exact payloads and their digests. Failure to persist REFUSES dispatch. It is separate so the terminal receipt's write-once semantics cannot erase it.
defect_1_intent_was_only_memory.root_wording: "out['planned_request_intent'] = planned is only memory until terminal finalization. In the actual-main witness, both barriers and both POST calls observe zero durable writes."
defect_1_intent_was_only_memory.what_it_actually_was: a dict in memory; if the supervisor died mid-dispatch nothing on disk said what it had been about to send
defect_1_intent_was_only_memory.witnessed_by: test_request_intent_is_ON_DISK_before_any_transport, which checks the file exists DURING the POST rather than trusting the receipt field

defect_2_a_timed_out_request_counted_as_.now: three distinct states: transport_attempted (recorded BEFORE the call), response_received, and delivery=unknown_server_receipt when the transport raises. A raised transport is not a request that was never made.
defect_2_a_timed_out_request_counted_as_.root_wording: "the new submission counter increments only after requests.post returns, so a request that was attempted and then timed out still counts as unsubmitted ... records submitted_requests=0 and incorrectly calls both 'never submitted'"

defect_3_response_tail_existed_nowhere.now: the bytes are written ONCE to <request_id>.response with O_EXCL before parsing; size and hash are MEASURED back from that file; a retention failure is stated and refuses
defect_3_response_tail_existed_nowhere.root_wording: "Length, hash and a 4,000-character preview cannot recover the omitted bytes. Valid responses longer than 9 KB return supervisor success while their tail bytes are absent from every persisted file."
defect_3_response_tail_existed_nowhere.same_finding_as: the diagnostic capture: a digest of discarded bytes is not a retained artifact
defect_3_response_tail_existed_nowhere.witnessed_by: test_the_WHOLE_response_body_is_on_disk_not_just_a_preview, with a 12,000-character body whose tail is recovered from the artifact

defect_4_the_launcher_is_not_the_impleme.now: each declared non-system library is measured from disk before Popen; a manifest that declares no closure REFUSES as a missing required input
defect_4_the_launcher_is_not_the_impleme.root_wording: "the actual non_system_library_closure declaration can name a sibling implementation library whose bytes have changed and still receive verified=true ... The small launcher is not the implementation."
defect_4_the_launcher_is_not_the_impleme.still_only_an_inventory: this checks the DECLARED members. It is not a proven transitive closure: dependencies of those libraries are not enumerated and no loader resolution is recorded.
defect_4_the_launcher_is_not_the_impleme.why_it_matters_here: the built launcher is 33,472 bytes; every line of instrumented server code lives in libllama-server-impl.dylib and the ggml backends beside it, so a two-file check could pass while the code that actually runs had changed
